verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing has a dedicated agents page describing scoped, single-use virtual cards, real-time authorization decisioning, spend controls, and full transaction visibility, backed by a full Cards/Cardholders API and a documented official MCP server for AI agents to interact with the Stripe API. This covers reading transactions/balances, creating/updating cards, and adjusting spend controls through API or MCP with scoped credentials as described in the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP server exposes Issuing-specific tools (vs generic Stripe API tools) and independent/hands-on corroboration of an agent operating a live card program end-to-end via MCP.
